messages:
Taylor: Hey team — I need to request an accommodation. My sensory issues (ADHD + sound sensitivity) have been getting worse with the open office noise and the new late on-call rotation. I’m asking for a quiet workspace option and temporary reassignment of my weekly on-call shifts for ~6 weeks while I get treatment.
David: Thanks for flagging this, Taylor. I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. We can discuss coverage but want to make sure we don’t leave the service short. I can try to reassign some of your rotation — can you list which dates you need covered?
Taylor: Thanks David. I’m asking to be removed from on-call for the next 4 weeks starting Mon Apr 7th (so Apr 7–May 4). If needed we can cover specific weekends instead of entire weeks. Also would like a quieter desk or access to a private room for heads-down work.
Maria (People Ops): Hi @Taylor — I’m Maria from People Ops. We can start an accommodations intake and set up temporary adjustments ASAP. Two quick asks: 1) please upload any supporting documentation if you have it (doctor note okay but not required), 2) confirm whether you want fully remote during work hours or just a quieter office room. We can set interim measures while we evaluate.
Taylor: I can upload a short note tomorrow. Prefer a quiet room + remote for focused afternoons (1–5pm) rather than full remote. On-call reassignment is the priority though.
Sasha (People Ops): I can help cover the on-call shifts. @David — would a partial swap work? Sasha can take Taylor’s rotation weeks Apr 7–May 4; Taylor returns May 5. If additional coverage needed, we can pull from rotation volunteers.
David: That swap should be OK as long as we update the schedule and on-call Slack rota. @Sasha thanks for stepping up. I’ll approve the swap pending Maria’s intake.
Facilities: Hi! We have a small focus room on 3B that we can reserve for Taylor starting Mon Apr 1. Also we can loan noise-cancelling headphones if helpful. Taylor, do you want us to reserve daily blocks (1–5pm) or full days?
Taylor: Daily blocks 1–5pm please. Headphones would be great. Thank you.
Maria (People Ops): Great — next steps: 1) Taylor uploads any doc to the accommodations intake form: https://redwood.accom/form (internal), 2) People Ops will provision the quiet room + headphones (Facilities), 3) Sasha will be temporarily added to on-call calendar Apr 7–May 4 and Taylor will be off rotation, 4) we’ll set a 2-week check-in (Apr 21) to review. This is temporary by default; we’ll discuss extensions if needed.
HR Bot: Accommodations intake submitted? (auto-reminder)
Taylor: I uploaded a short supporting note just now.
Maria (People Ops): Received, thank you. I’ve logged the request and marked it as priority. 
Maria (People Ops): Action items I’ve created: 
- Facilities: reserve focus room 3B daily 1–5pm Apr 1–May 4 + prepare headphones (assigned to Facilities)
- Ops: update on-call rota to assign Sasha Apr 7–May 4 (assigned to David/Sasha)
- People Ops: schedule Apr 21 check-in with Taylor + manager (assigned to Maria)
Facilities: Room and headphones reserved.
Sasha (People Ops): On-call rota updated, calendar invites sent to affected folks.
David: Sounds good. Taylor if anything changes with workload or you need partial overlap on certain on-call incidents ping me directly.
Taylor: Really appreciate everyone helping with this. I’ll keep you posted after the check-in. :white_check_mark:
Maria (People Ops): We’ll follow up Apr 21. If Taylor needs faster adjustments we can escalate. Thanks all for the quick responses. :pray:
